text: The stop-gate judge's class-sweep/proof check fires on a transform that is still IN FLIGHT in a leased writer (the 47-alias conversion, writer a023840, #d143cbdd): nothing has landed, yet it demands shape proof for a 'landed' bulk transform. A class-sweep or proof obligation should key on a TICKED item or a committed diff, not on an open lease's description; the owed proof belongs in the writer's tick evidence, which the lead has already required (class count 77 vs 47, shape_cluster_diff, per-package tsc/tests).

An interim SubagentStop from an agent that is still waiting on its own background task (text like 'waiting for the background test run', 'I'll wait for this notification') is captured as a [SILENT]/unread report and blocks the lead's stop every time, although it carries nothing to act on. P1.5 auto-read excludes [SILENT] on purpose; an interim-wait report whose agent is still live (a running background child) should be auto-read or held until the agent's final stop.

A submodule pointer 'move' in the shared tree can be the tree LAGGING the babysitter's snapshot commits (tree HEAD older than the recorded gitlink, with uncommitted work on top), not an intended move; neither 'stage it' nor 'git submodule update --checkout' is right then -- the next combined submodule commit resolves it. Check: git diff --cached shows nothing for the path and the recorded commit is a descendant of the tree HEAD.

The tick evidence check refuses a sha from a sibling (non-submodule) repo such as private/generative or private/growth: it resolves shas only in the console repo. Use the remote's commit URL as evidence, or teach the check to try git -C <each private/* repo>.

After TaskStop on a writer agent, the pre-agent cap guard can still count it as live (its transcript never shows end_turn); the slot stays blocked until another writer finishes. Check the roster with the guard's own listing before assuming a free slot.
